_meta.description: SYNTHETIC -32015 rejection for a hypothetical version 2 transaction requested with maxSupportedTransactionVersion 1. Not captured from any cluster: no version 2 exists. The message follows the wording of the real -32015 recorded on 2026-11-10 for a v1 transaction requested with max 0, with the version numbers raised by one. The signature is 64 bytes of 0x02, base58-encoded.
_meta.note: `response` mimics a JSON-RPC response body. See README.md.

error.message: Transaction version (2) is not supported by the requesting client. Please try the request again with the following configuration parameter: "maxSupportedTransactionVersion": 2
